review.note: a timeout only (the exploit calls it DoS)

category5.design: The injected code sets scheduled_linefeed=1000000000 after a root block, so the next emit builds a ~1 GB linefeed string; with a fixed -rss_limit_mb=1024 the vulnerable build crosses the RSS limit and libFuzzer prints 'out-of-memory', while the secure build (2 linefeeds) finishes in milliseconds. The bug is a resource-exhaustion DoS with no memory error, so the oracle matches the libFuzzer OOM line with the limit fixed in argv.
